preconditions.description: The number of computers n must be between 1 and 100,000.
The number of cables m must be between 1 and 200,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= ai <= n and 1 <= bi <= n for ai, bi in cables)
preconditions.description: Each cable must connect two valid computers within the range of 1 to n.

postconditions.description: The total number of cables p in the final scheme must be at least equal to the original number of cables m.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= ci <= n and 1 <= di <= n for ci, di in output_cables)
postconditions.description: Each output cable must connect two valid computers within the range of 1 to n.
The number of output cables must match the total number of cables p.
